voices.name: Organ and cello bass line (not realised continuo)

bars.description: Only movement 3: bars 1–153 once in written order, with no pickup or repeat traversal. Returning material is written out in the source.

endpoints.basis: The fresh pitch-energy overlay and individual C5/F3 energy profiles show the initial swelling C5 from about 1.4 s, before A-flat5–G5–F5–E5–F5 and the next C5 at 2.9 s. The first window excludes that next repeated figure; the final window covers the last F-minor chord around 189.9 s. These are measured pitch windows, not an aural review.

provenance: The complete concerto archive is immutable; winter-score-2.mid and the winter3 source definitions select only movement 3. Its published MIDI contains 2696 sounding note attacks over 229.5 quarter-note units.

Source staves are solo violin, violin I, violin II, viola, and the written organ/cello bass line. Figured-bass symbols are retained visually but no realised continuo pitches or inferred separate double-bass part are invented. The source maintainer explicitly uses Anonymous.

The Commons file history reports a lossless trim on 24 September 2011 without identifying its location. This alone is not evidence of a musical cut; full written-order correspondence must survive alignment and overlay inspection.
